FAQ
FrequentlyAskedQuestions
Is Hairstyle AI free to start?

Yes. Download free, get a free style analysis to begin, and only upgrade when you want more looks or higher-detail Pro results.

How realistic are the results?

Very. Pro mode keeps your face, skin tone, and lighting while it swaps the hair — realistic enough to show your stylist or post as-is.

Does it work for my hair type and face shape?

Yes. It works across textures, lengths, and face shapes — and it can analyze your face shape to suggest cuts that actually suit you.

Can I try hair, color, and beard together?

Yes. Test cuts, colors, and facial hair on the same photo, compare up to five looks, and save the winner to bring to your barber.

What devices are supported?

Hairstyle AI is available on both iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android. You can download it from the App Store or Google Play.
